speaker.name: Dr. Israr Ahmed
speaker.note: Founder of Tanzeem-e-Islami and the Quran Academy. This catalogue links to material published by the official Tanzeem-e-Islami archive.

source.coverage: Pages 1–10 of the official speaker archive (150 most recent listing entries), retrieved 26 October 2026.
source.duplicateNote: Some archive listing pages embed the same YouTube upload as another entry. Those records are retained because they exist on the source, but they are flagged with duplicateOf so the unique video count stays honest.

rights.hosting: NoorDeen does not host, copy or re-upload any video file. Each entry embeds the official YouTube upload or links to the original Tanzeem-e-Islami page.
rights.embedPolicy: YouTube privacy-enhanced embeds (youtube-nocookie.com) are used and only loaded on user action.
